title: the Colour Studio and the store on the Home Screen, styled like treasure
lensAText: a sceptical automotive colour and UI designer. Look at every frame the builder cites with the Read tool, then take your own in ONE short Playwright script on dist/artifact.html at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, DPR 3, isMobile, hasTouch) and 1450x767: open the store and the garage, buy the Colour Studio with the test card (test mode), then apply several body + caliper combinations on the Rossini GT, the Rossini Corsa and the OC Hypercar (garage stage, chase camera Day and Night). Judge: are all nine body colours and nine caliper colours distinct, attractive and correct on every car (paint finish believable, calipers visibly coloured through the wheels), is the picker clear and quick on a phone with a live preview, are factory colours still free, are the paint packs gone from the store with nothing broken, and is the store honest (test mode, 13+/18+ rules as set)? ALSO judge the Home Screen store panel: does it feel like treasure and make you want to look, while staying honest (no mystery boxes, timers or pressure), readable and uncluttered on a phone?
brief: THE OWNER (2026-11-11 ~6:30-6:40 PM PT): "another option will be car color that lets you choose between 9 colors of the cars and calipers"; then "4.99 is good, keep those colors and also get rid of the paint pack". BUILD: (1) ONE store item 'Colour Studio' (src/store/catalog.json, src/store/cosmetics.json; then npm run store:sync and npm run store:check), $4.99 one time (price_cents 499), test mode only, for EVERY car (the Rossinis, the Vela E, the OC Hypercar and any future car), granting NINE body colours and NINE caliper colours that the player mixes and matches. Body colours (our own names): Pacific Pearl White, Huntington Racing Red, Irvine Liquid Silver, Balboa Bay Teal, Corona del Mar Emerald, Anaheim Electric Blue, Seal Beach Satin Black, Fullerton Acid Yellow, Mission Viejo Violet (choose believable hexes and finishes from the existing paint_finishes: pearl, metallic, satin, gloss). Caliper colours: Signal Red, Racing Yellow, Ice Blue, Lime Green, Bronze, Violet, Sunset Orange, Gloss Black, Polished Silver. (2) REMOVE the two paint-pack items (paint-pack-coast, paint-pack-freeway-nights) from the store; the eight paints they held STAY inside the Founder Pack (update its description so it no longer mentions paint packs); fix every test, store check and UI reference to the removed SKUs. (3) A GARAGE COLOUR PICKER: body and caliper choices side by side with swatches and names, a live preview on the garage car, saved per car in the profile; factory colours always free and selectable; owned Colour Studio colours unlocked, otherwise shown with the store link; bought paints from the Founder Pack keep working. Calipers are drawn by src/preview/car-wheel.ts, which belongs to another session: do NOT edit it; drive the caliper colour through the existing data path (the wheel's caliper swatch / material the game already passes in) and, if no such path exists for a car, report exactly what the other session must add instead of editing their file. (5) THE STORE ON THE HOME SCREEN (THE OWNER, 2026-11-11 ~7:55 PM PT: "Make the store menu part of the Home Screen but make it very appealing like treasure"): put the store right on the main menu/Home Screen as a striking 'treasure' panel: a rich vault or treasure look in the game's own style (deep blacks, warm gold and the style guide's accents, glints, a soft glow, depth, a subtle idle shimmer that stops under reduced motion), showing the featured items with their pictures, names and real prices (the OC Hypercar Founder Edition $9.99, the Founder Pack, the Colour Studio $4.99, and the Chad/Chadaline pack as 'coming soon' $22.22 when its entry exists), opening the full store in one tap; on phones it must stay tappable, readable and not crowd the Play buttons or the Character entry. RULES: the treasure is a LOOK only: no mystery boxes, random rewards, spinning wheels, fake countdowns, fake scarcity or pressure copy (CLAUDE.md: no loot boxes; honest claims); every item shows exactly what it is and costs; the real Founder window date may be shown; the test-mode label stays visible while the store is in test mode; purchases 13+ (and the pack 18+ when it goes on sale). The characters lane also adds a Character entry to the main menu: lay the two out together cleanly (if both exist when you merge, keep both). Frames: the Home Screen with the treasure panel at 390x844 (DPR 3) and 1450x767, and the store opened from it. (4b) Keep the store rules: test mode until the owner says live, nothing sold before it exists, our own names, no real brands. ADD a regression check: the Colour Studio entry is priced 499 and grants 9+9; the paint packs are gone; applying a body and a caliper colour changes the car's paint and caliper materials and persists across a reload. Avoid files other lanes are changing where you can: src/preview/cockpit.ts and src/preview/wheel-sport.ts (the dashboard lane), src/game/drivers.ts and src/onfoot/** (the characters lane), the settings overlay files of the fast-settings lane; and never the other session's files (src/preview/hands*, src/onfoot/people/*, src/preview/car-wheel.ts, src/game/vehicle/Physics.ts, src/preview/spec.ts). PROVE: npx tsc --noEmit; npm run store:sync && npm run store:check; npm run build (one owner-test mark); npm test -- --only=boot,phone,modes and the new check; frames into tests/out/colour-studio/: the store at 390x844 and 1450x767, the picker, and a 3x3 contact sheet of body colours and one of caliper colours on the Rossini GT and the OC Hypercar (garage stage, Day).
